name: Dni nigde
source: When everyone left their camps, there were only two Pioneers left in the deserted system. On an endless road in the middle of an endless wasteland, nothing and no one is waiting for them. Hundreds of empty, identical days have passed and thousands more will pass. The sun never sets in this place, the wind does not rustle, and even the clouds in the eternally cold sky remain motionless. When the future was taken from them, and the present turned into an unchanging purgatory, all they had to do was remember the past.
